visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable frames against local Qualla photographs and aerial context. Main quadrangle, projecting west entrance, south pavilions and stair, bowed north range, long north wing, two service courtyards, orangery, open belvedere and return gateway are represented. Final review moved gatehouse windows onto the exterior wall faces; full current north turntable checked.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views including footprint overlay. Sandstone, painted roof metal and timber use three shared metric surfaces; glass remains local. Pilasters, window rhythms, cornices, urns and balustrades remain legible. Flat-ground views are material fixtures; portable views retain independent terrain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen current lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Skyline retains courtyard, main house, long wing, tower opening and three-arch gateway. District restores facade rhythms and roof lanterns; street/closeup add surrounds, glazing bars, balusters, capitals, urn profiles and roof seams. Fine repeated details were reduced to meet all four budgets. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures; no physical-device performance measurement claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Anchor [-1.6117,53.22717], heading 0: +X east and +Z south. Main quadrangle and north service-wing/gateway envelope follow mapped geometry; rear service courts are refined from aerial context. Unmodified Terrarium datum 119.1626 m at west approach [-33,0]. West entrance Y=0.55; main upper floor Y=5.3 and basement extending to -3.2 accommodate the terrain rise toward south/east. Ground is retained unchanged; footprint replacement disabled.

fidelityReview.scope: Main house, open court, attached north wing, service courts, orangery, belvedere and return gate range; detached stables, gardens and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Six individually inspected Qualla originals, four visually inspected pages of the official visitor plan, Historic England architectural description and aerial context inform the exterior. Dimensions, hidden joins and fine ornament remain estimates; visitor diagrams are not measured surveys. Pediment sculpture, carved relief, fine capitals and exact urn ornament are simplified or omitted. No photographic pixels, interior contents or vegetation reproduced.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets; exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.
